symptom: a stiff upper back in an older man who still had a good range of movement in his neck
hook: the spine looked like candle wax had been poured down the front of it and left to set
whatYouSee: A thick ribbon of new bone flows down the front of the spine across several vertebrae. The discs underneath are still normal height.
whyItMatters: The ligament along the front of the spine turns to bone and stiffens it and a spine this brittle can fracture across all its layers after a minor fall.
treatment: Care is aimed at stiffness and pain with physiotherapy and analgesia while any fracture in this rigid spine is treated as unstable.
takeaway: Flowing candle wax bone down four vertebrae with normal discs is DISH.
